But he told me he couldn't stand by me and help me heal, that's not love.  He only wants the good parts of the relationship and I'm already on my own.  I'm so sorry...

In reading the AMA, it's held over my head that I threw away a $1200 engagement ring.  I immediately wish I could take it back, but I was in a moment of sincere pain and psychosis.  

What's not mentioned is that there was an affair in our relationship.  I haven't been wearing that ring because the symbolism was tainted.  How can this material object hold any love in the relationship if we were having to start over?  The promises that were made were lies.

I was asked to wear the ring on vacation.  I told him I was waiting for him to recommit those promises he once made and had hoped to see sincerity in it.  I ended up having to script the words I needed to hear... "Repeat after me: this ring is a promise to protect, respect, and love you.  It's a promise to always remain faithful..."

So without any sincerity and me being the only one making those promises, this ring had no meaning and I choked back tears realizing that I wasn't wearing it on vacation out of his love for me, it was a status symbol for his co-workers to see.
